dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdOtherChange, stored in .ledger/other-changes.json with a version and an audience. `ledger other-change` is an alias in src/cli.mjs.

history.name: Recording a product-wide change
history.description: The command ledger other-change records something that runs across the whole product, such as a wording pass over many screens or a change in what a colour means. It prints once at the end of the edition, under the heading Also since last time, instead of forcing the same note onto a dozen unrelated entries.

The command ledger note records something that runs across the whole product, such as a wording pass over many screens or a change in what a colour means. It prints once at the end of the edition, under the heading Also since last time, instead of forcing the same note onto a dozen unrelated entries.
The command ledger note records something that runs across the whole product, such as a wording pass over many screens. The edition lists it once, under Across the product.
history.how_to_see: Run ledger note --audience user --description with one sentence, then ledger preview: the note is listed under Across the product on the first page and in The changes in detail.

events.what: A product-wide note is listed on the edition's first page and printed with the changes in detail under Across the product, instead of at the end of the edition.
events.why: A brief explanation of what changed is a good start of this document.
